## Current research

### Sunflower lipid engineering

At the University of Hyderabad, I contribute to an ANRF-funded project investigating sunflower lipid metabolism through genome editing and metabolic engineering. My work includes CRISPR/Cas9 strategy design, vector construction, sunflower transformation and tissue culture, regeneration optimisation, genotyping, and GC-MS/MS-based lipid profiling.

<div class="callout">Research goal: understand and engineer sunflower lipid metabolism to increase TAG content and alter fatty-acid composition, including omega-3 enrichment.</div>

## From analytical research to plant biotechnology

My previous work in regulated bioanalysis involved LC-MS/MS method development and validation across 34 BA/BE projects. This analytical foundation now supports my plant research by connecting molecular and genetic interventions with quantitative metabolic phenotypes.
